scope: Complete structural family audit; eight current representative complete-preset phrases plus named controls; prior .6 full-family phrases reused explicitly.

control_overrides.tempo_jump: transport 60 to 180 BPM at exactly 3 seconds

method.motion_metric: Stereo RMS difference and gain-normalized first-difference brightness ratios, 50 adjacent 100 ms windows between 1 and 6 seconds.
method.articulation_metric: For complete onset/off/next-on triples after one second, compare stereo RMS in 65-90% of the released gap with RMS in 15-45% of the preceding held gate. Boundaries use public callback-end telemetry; tails are preserved.
method.capture_cli_limit: preset_capture holds a single source MIDI note; arp remains enabled, but generic summary metrics alone cannot prove multi-key order, scheduled gate timing, or tempo behavior.

build_setup.archive_extraction: Complete archived src tree for baseline ABI compatibility
